ideas.monetization: SaaS for premium analytics, custom benchmark creation, and API access for automated testing. Free tier for basic benchmark viewing.

ideas.name: Age Verification Gateway
ideas.problem: Businesses requiring age verification for content or services face regulatory challenges and user privacy concerns. This app provides a secure and privacy-preserving method for users to verify their age once, which can then be attested to by businesses, minimizing data sharing.
ideas.monetization: SaaS for businesses on a per-verification or subscription basis, with a small one-time fee for users to create and manage their verified profile.
